title: Phantom Blade Zero Boss Guide - All Known Bosses & Strategies
description: Complete Phantom Blade Zero boss guide. All confirmed bosses from demos and trailers, with combat tips and strategies for each encounter.

sections.title: Boss Overview
sections.content:
Phantom Blade Zero features numerous boss encounters throughout its 20-30 hour campaign. Bosses are known for aggressive AI, multi-phase fights, and rewarding unique weapons upon defeat.

Below is every boss confirmed through official demos, trailers, and the August 2026 State of Play showcase.

sections.title: Puppet Boss (String Puppet) — Demo Verified
sections.content:
The Puppet Boss was the first boss publicly demonstrated. This puppeteer-like opponent uses strings to control attacks from range while delivering swift melee strikes up close.

Key Mechanics

  • String attacks — Ranged strings that sweep the arena. Jump or dodge to avoid.
  • Puppet summons — Spawns smaller puppet minions. Clear them quickly or they'll overwhelm you.
  • Close-range combos — Fast melee sequences when you get close. Parry timing is tight.

Strategy Tips

  • Stay at medium range to bait string attacks, then close in during recovery
  • Parry the melee combos for massive counter-damage
  • Use Shachi weapons for ranged damage during puppet summon phases
  • Watch for the glowing string telegraph — it always precedes the sweep attack

sections.title: Huangxing — Demo Verified
sections.content:
Huangxing is an aggressive warrior boss featured in the 4K Demo. Known for relentless pressure and powerful sword techniques.

Key Mechanics

  • Fast multi-hit sword combos
  • Unblockable grab attack (dodge sideways)
  • Rage phase at low health with increased speed

Strategy Tips

  • Parry is essential — his combos have consistent rhythm
  • Dual Swords work well for matching his speed
  • Save your Phantom Edge for the rage phase

sections.title: General Boss Fight Tips
sections.content:
• Learn the parry timing — Every boss has parryable attacks. The counter-damage is always worth the risk.
  • Boss-specific weapons — Some bosses drop unique weapons. These are often among the best in the game.
  • NPC vendors sell consumables — Stock up on healing items from NPC merchants before boss encounters.
  • Watch for red flash — Unblockable/unparryable attacks are telegraphed with a red indicator. Dodge these.
  • Multi-phase fights — Most bosses have at least 2 phases. Save your strongest Phantom Edge abilities for phase 2.
  • Death costs days — Remember, dying pushes your 66-day timer forward. If you're stuck, consider leveling up elsewhere first.

Full detailed strategies with frame data and optimal loadouts will be added at launch.
